Messages.Author: mbi...@ibm.net
Messages.Body:
I need to know the official ruling on whether or not Army of Rats is cumulative. In other words, if my predator has 3 Army of Rats up, do I lose 3 pool during his untap, or only one?

Vincent, Elder of Minneapolis

Messages.Author: Chris Congdon
Messages.Body:



>Vincent, Elder of Minneapolis

The way we play is that it *is* cumulative. It doesn't say otherwise....

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
con...@indy.net (Chris Congdon) writes:




>>Vincent, Elder of Minneapolis



The official ruling from Tom is that AoR are not cumulative. This is
errata.

Messages.Author: Eric Martin Eslinger
Messages.Body:
mbi...@ibm.net wrote:
: I need to know the official ruling on whether or not Army of Rats is cumulative. In other words, if my predator has 3 Army of Rats up, do I lose 3 pool during his untap, or only one?

: Vincent, Elder of Minneapolis

I believe the official ruling is that it is _not_ cumulative. Having three out
simply means that it is much more difficult to avoid the loss of pool.
